in_marathi.name: Pritesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pritesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pritesh is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Pri' meaning 'Lord' and 'Tesh' meaning 'Wealth'. It is believed that this name invokes the blessings of the Lord of Wealth, and is a source of prosperity and abundance.
